title: Shoulder Aids
description: Arm slings, shoulder immobilisers, and clavicle braces for fracture management, post-operative care, and shoulder rehabilitation.

products.name: Arm Sling
products.sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL, Child
features: Durable cotton-poly blend fabric with padded neck strap
Adjustable length to position forearm at 90° elbow flexion
Wide body panel distributes weight evenly across the shoulder
Available in adult and paediatric sizes
benefits: Offloads the weight of the arm to reduce shoulder and elbow strain
Promotes healing after fractures, dislocations, and soft tissue injuries
Keeps the arm protected and elevated to minimise swelling
Easy to apply with one hand, suitable for use at home

products.name: Arm Sling Tropical
products.sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL, Child
features: Open-weave breathable mesh fabric ideal for warm climates
Padded, ventilated neck strap prevents skin irritation
Adjustable forearm cradle with reinforced stitching
Lightweight construction minimises heat retention
benefits: Keeps the arm cool and comfortable in humid or hot environments
Reduces perspiration and skin maceration under the sling
Suitable for post-fracture and post-surgical immobilisation in summer conditions
Ideal for patients in tropical regions who wear slings for extended periods

products.name: Arm Sling Strap
features: Simple over-the-shoulder strap design for quick application
Padded contact zones to prevent pressure marks
Universal fit accommodates most adult arm sizes
Adjustable buckle for precise arm height control
benefits: Provides basic arm support for minor sprains and post-injury care
Quick and easy alternative to traditional cradle slings
Reduces downward traction on the shoulder joint
Suitable for short-term immobilisation during daily activities

products.name: Shoulder Support
features: Elastic neoprene construction provides uniform compression
Contoured shoulder cup for anatomical fit
Cross-chest and underarm straps for secure positioning
Can be worn discreetly under clothing
benefits: Compresses and supports the glenohumeral joint to reduce pain
Helps manage rotator cuff injuries, impingement, and joint instability
Retains body heat to relax tight shoulder muscles
Allows functional shoulder movement while limiting painful arcs

products.name: Shoulder Immobilizer
features: Combines arm sling with body brace to restrict shoulder abduction
Foam-padded straps prevent pressure points at axilla and waist
Waist belt secures the arm close to the body
Paediatric and adult sizes available
benefits: Immobilises the shoulder after dislocation, fracture, or rotator cuff repair
Prevents accidental abduction that could disrupt surgical repair
Reduces post-operative pain by eliminating involuntary arm movement
Used routinely in shoulder surgery aftercare protocols

products.name: Elastic Shoulder Immobilizer
features: Elastic fabric body brace with integrated arm pouch
Stretch construction adapts to varied body shapes
Breathable material minimises moisture build-up
Hook-and-loop closure for simple single-hand application
benefits: Provides comfortable shoulder immobilisation post-dislocation or surgery
Elastic design accommodates post-operative swelling
Suitable for use during sleep to prevent inadvertent shoulder movement
Lightweight and less bulky than rigid shoulder immobilisers

products.name: Clavical Brace Stockinette
features: Figure-of-eight design corrects clavicle alignment
Stockinette padding prevents axillary skin irritation
Adjustable posterior tension for customised correction force
Breathable cotton-mix construction
benefits: Reduces clavicle fracture displacement to encourage anatomical healing
Retracts the shoulders to correct rounded posture following clavicle injury
Minimises pain by stabilising fracture fragments during early healing
Standard of care for conservative management of mid-shaft clavicle fractures
